entities.name_en: The Guardians of the Peace (national police)

evidence.note: pressoffice@garda.ie; also foi@garda.ie and access.officer@garda.ie on official contact pages

entities.notes: Single national police; also handles state security via the Crime & Security Branch and immigration via the Garda National Immigration Bureau.

entities.name_native: An Roinn Dlí agus Cirt / Department of Justice

evidence.note: info@justice.ie, accessofficer@justice.ie on gov.ie listing; oireachtasqueries@justice.ie in Oireachtas records

entities.notes: Website on gov.ie portal; mail domain justice.ie. Immigration Service Delivery sits here.

entities.name_native: An Roinn Cosanta / Department of Defence

evidence.note: No defence.ie address evidenced in research; historical department domain, assumed. Website now on gov.ie portal

entities.name_en: Irish Defence Forces (incl. Directorate of Military Intelligence J2)

evidence.note: recruitment@defenceforces.ie, foi@defenceforces.ie, pss@defenceforces.ie on official contact pages

entities.notes: Military intelligence (J2) is a directorate of the Defence Forces, not a standalone agency.

evidence.note: info@ncsc.gov.ie (general), incident@ncsc.gov.ie / certreport@ncsc.gov.ie (incident reporting; certreport also in RFC2350 at ncsc.gov.ie/pdfs/RFC2350%20NCSC-IE.txt)

entities.notes: Part of the Department of the Environment, Climate and Communications; hosts the national CSIRT (CSIRT-IE).

gaps: intelligence: no standalone civilian intelligence agency — functions split between An Garda Síochána (Crime & Security Branch, domestic security) and Defence Forces Directorate of Military Intelligence (J2)
border_guard: no standalone border agency — immigration control by Garda National Immigration Bureau (part of AGS) and Immigration Service Delivery (part of Department of Justice)
